native.ib_device_profile: Actual equipment and manual revision; generic equipment cannot inherit BC4000 PLC defaults.
native.ib_configuration_phase: Actual values versus source-qualified factory proposals; no automatically confirmed hardware.
native.ib_role: Actual ring master, slave or system coupler; internal PLC does not imply fieldbus master.
native.ib_segment_kind: Actual local or remote ring; installation remote needs independently registered PHY evidence.
native.ib_cycle_kind: Actual initialization/identification or process-data cycle; PCP traffic needs its own channel budget.
native.ib_bitrate_bps: Actual selected segment clock;500k is reviewed baseline,2M requires every applicable participant to support it.
native.ib_medium: Actual paired copper or optical PHY; local Inline and remote cable are independent.
native.ib_device_source: Actual firmware/identity/limits and configured register evidence.
native.ib_master_source: Actual selected master/firmware and separate ring capacity proof.
native.ib_physical_source: Actual connectors, cable/segment/length/power and homogeneous selected clock.
native.ib_schedule_source: Actual master cycle and application release/read/write schedule.
native.ib_ring_binding: Actual canonical ring/interface binding, not an automatically assigned CAN ID.
native.ib_node_identity: Actual unique physical station identity/order and approved configuration.
native.ib_coupled_ring_binding: Actual other independent ring of the system coupler.
native.ib_station_order: Actual discovered ring order; not manufacturer ID or project-assigned CAN address.
native.ib_input_bytes: Actual station fieldbus input process image, not local PLC storage.
native.ib_output_bytes: Actual station fieldbus output process image.
native.ib_effective_words: Actual non-rounded periphery register words; not sum of independent IN+OUT images.
native.ib_id_words: Actual encoded register width, with device-specific rounding.
native.ib_id_code: Actual ID-cycle module class; not manufacturer identity.
native.ib_total_nodes: Actual nodes on the selected master ring.
native.ib_local_nodes: Actual local station count; actual power budget may reduce maximum.
native.ib_remote_branches: Actual remote branches; local-only master forbids these.
native.ib_pcp_nodes: Actual participants using the parameter channel, not whole ring device count.
native.ib_master_io_bits: Actual combined input+output allocation, distinct from register length.
native.ib_master_register_bytes: Actual master register allocation, not a PCP message-size ceiling.
native.ib_local_plc_input_bytes: Actual local PLC input storage, not fieldbus bytes.
native.ib_local_plc_output_bytes: Actual local PLC output storage, not fieldbus bytes.
native.ib_local_terminals: Actual BC K-bus allocation, not global ring nodes.
native.ib_pcp_service_bytes: Actual complete device-accepted PCP service size, unknown until actual service/peer evidence.
native.ib_peer_pcp_service_limit: Actual PCP peer service size, not universal246-byte process image.
native.ib_cycle_effective_bytes: Actual full ring effective bytes for qualified timing formula, not words.
native.ib_cycle_couplers: Actual couplers for qualified timing formula.
native.ib_hop_length_m: Actual measured hop_length_m with applicable segment/medium/device limits.
native.ib_ring_length_m: Actual measured ring_length_m with applicable segment/medium/device limits.
native.ib_timing_model: Actual measured/verified model versus BC manual500k ring estimate; estimate alone is not complete capacity or E2E proof.
native.ib_model_cycle_ms: Actual or qualified-model model_cycle_ms; ring and full functional latency remain separate.
native.ib_ring_reaction_ms: Actual or qualified-model ring_reaction_ms; ring and full functional latency remain separate.
native.ib_error_recovery_ms: Actual or qualified-model error_recovery_ms; ring and full functional latency remain separate.
native.ib_controller_master_ms: Actual or qualified-model controller_master_ms; ring and full functional latency remain separate.
native.ib_coupler_output_ms: Actual or qualified-model coupler_output_ms; ring and full functional latency remain separate.
native.ib_application_bound_ms: Actual or qualified-model application_bound_ms; ring and full functional latency remain separate.
native.ib_bc_input_offset: Actual BC4000 register bc_input_offset; other BC8x00/BC9000 table columns do not apply.
native.ib_bc_output_offset: Actual BC4000 register bc_output_offset; other BC8x00/BC9000 table columns do not apply.
native.ib_bc_digital_input_offset: Actual BC4000 register bc_digital_input_offset; other BC8x00/BC9000 table columns do not apply.
native.ib_bc_digital_output_offset: Actual BC4000 register bc_digital_output_offset; other BC8x00/BC9000 table columns do not apply.
native.ib_bc_plc_cycle_ms: Actual BC4000 register bc_plc_cycle_ms; other BC8x00/BC9000 table columns do not apply.
native.ib_bc_background_ms: Actual BC4000 register bc_background_ms; other BC8x00/BC9000 table columns do not apply.
native.ib_bc_remanent_bytes: Actual BC4000 register bc_remanent_bytes; other BC8x00/BC9000 table columns do not apply.
native.ib_bc_persistent_bytes: Actual BC4000 register bc_persistent_bytes; other BC8x00/BC9000 table columns do not apply.
native.ib_bc_autorefresh_cycles: Actual BC4000 register bc_autorefresh_cycles; other BC8x00/BC9000 table columns do not apply.
native.ib_bc_autorefresh_retries: Actual BC4000 register bc_autorefresh_retries; other BC8x00/BC9000 table columns do not apply.
native.ib_bc_kbus_update: Actual BC4000 K-bus update relative to local PLC, not INTERBUS arbitration.
native.ib_bc_first_terminal_mapping: Actual first BC terminal mapping; no invented configured project terminal.
native.ib_bc_other_terminal_mapping: Actual mapping policy for subsequent BC terminals; actual individual overrides require evidence.
native.ib_pci_slave_configuration: Actual PCI SC slave DIP10 configuration source; OFF ignores baud/ID DIP positions.
native.ib_pci_slave_bitrate_bps: Actual independent upper-ring slave clock, not forced equal to lower-ring master.
native.ib_pci_slave_id_code: Actual PCI SC slave ID code, not BC4000 ID51.
native.ib_pci_slave_words: Actual PCI SC slave process words; discrete DIP lengths0..14 or16, combined process and PCP width at most16.
native.ib_pci_pcp_words: Actual PCI SC slave parameter-channel words;0,1,2 or4 with matching ID code.
native.ib_pci_power_loss_error: Actual PCI SC slave power-loss behavior.
native.payload_bytes: Actual selected process-data/PCP application bytes; directional image and rounded ID-register width are independent from service-size/peer limits and local PLC storage.
